heading: Dahiriah youth association is a non- governmental organisation concerned with persons with disabilities
title: Shabab Al-Balad
description: a non-governmental organization established in  2016  with the aim of improving the quality of life for people with disabilities in Palestine, particularly in the city of Al-Dhahiriya. The association focuses on promoting sustainable development and ensuring the effective and full integration of people with disabilities into society.
vision: Shabab Al-Balad Association strives for an inclusive and just society where all individuals, including those with disabilities, have equal opportunities for participation, development, and prosperity.
mission: The association works to improve the quality of life for people with disabilities by providing support, training, and awareness, enhancing their rights and ensuring their full and effective participation in society.
goal-1: Work on integrating people with disabilities into all aspects of community and economic life.
goal-2: Provide training and educational programs for people with disabilities to develop their skills and increase their employment opportunities.
goal-3: Raise awareness about the rights of people with disabilities and change negative perceptions towards them.
goal-4: Offer legal advice and support to ensure the legal rights of people with disabilities.
goal-5: Implement developmental projects and community initiatives aimed at improving the living environment for people with disabilities.
slogan: Towards an inclusive and just society for all
